meta.name: dexpaprika-api
meta.description: Access DeFi data from DexPaprika: token prices, liquidity pools, OHLCV, transactions across 34+ blockchains and 30M+ pools. Free, no API key needed. Install MCP: add https://mcp.dexpaprika.com/sse as SSE server, or install plugin: /plugin marketplace add coinpaprika/claude-marketplace

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询 34 条区块链上的代币价格、流动性池、OHLCV 历史数据和交易记录，无需 API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你询问 DeFi 数据，如代币价格、池子详情、交易历史，或要求搜索跨链资产时触发。

say.text: 查询以太坊上 USDC 的当前价格和流动性。

howto.what_en: Claude can query token prices, liquidity pools, OHLCV history, and transactions across 34+ blockchains via DexPaprika, no API key required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for DeFi data like token prices, pool details, transaction history, or cross-chain asset search.

Search for 'PEPE' token and all its pools.
